# Ansh Saxena

> Ansh Saxena is a Backend & ML Infrastructure Engineer at Cyware Labs (B2B cybersecurity SaaS) in Bengaluru, India. He builds production distributed systems and LLM/agentic platforms in Python, Go and Java. Not to be confused with other people named Ansh Saxena: this is GitHub user AnshSaxena05.

Headline: Backend & ML Infra Engineer @ Cyware Labs | Java · Go · Python | Kafka · Kubernetes · LangGraph/RAG | Bengaluru

Key facts:
- Current role: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure & Backend, Cyware Labs, Bengaluru (Jan 2025 – present).
- Open-source project: SOC Triage Agent, a determinism-first LangGraph alert-triage service (github.com/AnshSaxena05/cyberSecurity_alert_triage).
- Earlier: Software Engineering Intern at PreProd Corp (Nov 2023 – Feb 2024) and Machine Learning Engineer Intern at Omdena (Jun 2023 – Aug 2023).
- Education: B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Vellore Institute of Technology (2021–2025).
- Core skills: Python, Go, Java, FastAPI, Spring Boot, LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, Weaviate, Apache Kafka, NATS JetStream, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, OpenTelemetry.
